findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/GroupTheory/Index.lean:676 `IsFiniteRelIndex.to_finiteIndex_subgroupOf`; Index.lean:558 `finite_quotient_of_pretransitive_of_index_ne_zero`; `Order/OfVanishing.lean:221` `orderOfVanishingAt_smul`; the new docstring at Orbits.lean:193-195 states the step exists and is not taken; `grep -rn finite_orbit_mk_image_setOf_orderOfVanishingAt_ne_zero TauCeti` returns only the declaration and its module-doc entry — no consumer.
findings.fix: State the conclusion over `MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient Γ ℍ` with `Γ := 𝒢.comap (mapGL ℝ)`, and obtain the `SL(2, ℤ)` form as the image of it if it is still wanted. The extra step is: `Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex.to_finiteIndex_subgroupOf` gives `Γ.FiniteIndex` (via `𝒮ℒ ≃ SL(2, ℤ)`, `mapGL` being injective), then `Subgroup.finite_quotient_of_pretransitive_of_index_ne_zero` splits each `SL(2, ℤ)`-orbit into finitely many `Γ`-orbits; `orderOfVanishingAt f` is `Γ`-invariant by `orderOfVanishingAt_smul` (det = 1 > 0).
findings.issue: Under-generalized conclusion. The natural statement at hypothesis `[𝒢.IsFiniteRelIndex 𝒮ℒ]` is finiteness of the image in `MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient Γ ℍ` for `Γ := 𝒢.comap (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ) : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)`; the `SL(2, ℤ)`-orbit version proved here is the strictly weaker image of that, has no in-repo consumer, and does not reach the `Σ_{P ∈ Γ\ℍ*}` divisor index the PR cites as its milestone (roadmap `TauCetiRoadmap/ModularForms/README.md:330-338`).

summary: The lemma stops one readily-available step short of its natural level: it quotients by all of `SL(2, ℤ)` rather than by the finite-index subgroup attached to `𝒢`, which is the index the cited roadmap milestone (`Σ_{P ∈ Γ\ℍ*}`) needs. The docstring itself concedes the missing step, and the strengthening is two existing Mathlib lemmas away.
